title: Enabling Privacy-Preserving Natural Language Access to Industrial Smart Meter Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.09372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Energy management officers and grid operators increasingly rely on smart meter data for anomaly detection, performance monitoring, and strategic decision-making. However, extracting actionable insights from large-scale, heterogeneous telemetry databases requires advanced SQL and data engineering expertise, creating a critical bottleneck for non-technical personnel. Furthermore, the strict data privacy regulations and security constraints inherent to critical energy infrastructure often prohibit the routing of sensitive consumer data through cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs). To address these challenges, we present OpenMeter, a schema-agnostic Multi-Agent System (MAS) designed to translate natural language queries into executable code and human-readable insights. translated_title: 实现工业智能电表数据的隐私保护自然语言访问
translated_abstract: 能源管理人员和电网运营商日益依赖智能电表数据进行异常检测、性能监控和战略决策。然而，从大规模、异构的遥测数据库中提取可操作的业务洞察需要高级的SQL和数据工程专业知识，这对非技术人员来说是一个关键瓶颈。此外，关键能源基础设施所固有的严格数据隐私法规和安全约束，通常禁止将敏感的消费者数据通过基于云的大语言模型（LLM）进行处理。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了OpenMeter，一个与模式无关的多智能体系统（MAS），旨在将自然语言查询转换为可执行的代码和人类可读的洞察。该架构通过让非专家人员能够通过直观的方式与复杂数据库交互，降低了日常公用事业运营的技术门槛。
tldr: 本文提出OpenMeter，一个隐私保护、与模式无关的多智能体系统，可将自然语言查询转换为可执行代码，使非技术人员无需SQL专业知识即可安全地访问和分析工业智能电表数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents OpenMeter, a privacy-preserving, schema-agnostic Multi-Agent System that translates natural language queries into executable code, enabling non-technical personnel to securely access and analyze industrial smart meter data without SQL expertise.
